task: T78: regression on Δmid + EV-gated decision + 6 time features (schemeQ)
decision: REJECT — time features do not help in regression either
notes: Adding the 6 stateless time features (T74 schemeQ: sec_norm, sin/cos session position, is_open_30min, is_close_30min, is_pm) to the regression model (T75) marginally underperforms the time-feature-free baseline (-0.72 LOSO-equiv vs iter_013 +36.23). Single-seed test correlation is ~equal (0.150 vs 0.153). The single-seed EV-gate (k=1) is also slightly worse on average (29.62 vs 30.20). Per-sym breakdown shows the regression-on-schemeQ ensemble redistributes pnl: +0.75 sym0, -1.00 sym1, -0.53 sym2, ±0.0 sym3/4. The most plausible explanation is that the regressor was already learning whatever session-position signal exists implicitly through the LOB microstructure (spread widths, trade intensity etc.), and the explicit time feature primarily adds an extra split dimension that fits training-window-specific intraday-volatility quirks that don't generalize to date 96-119. This rules out time features for the current regression-EV stack — same conclusion as T74 for 3-class classification, but also for the more magnitude-sensitive regression objective. iter_013 stays as the SOTA submission. Save model and pred files for future ablation, do not package.
